changes.detail: Removed six exact duplicate entrance-deck faces left by R12.5 and fifteen exact duplicate faces at high roof-shell segment seams. Object and collection counts are unchanged.
Reduced inferred shell thickness from 0.30 m to 0.18 m. Orthophoto-traced roof/eaves XY is preserved; height profile is unchanged and remains inferred.
Added ARMS_R12_8_Wing_Soffit_ACM and assigned it to 160 high-canopy faces. The original low entrance awning retains its original material.

sources_and_scope.title: Design and Build with Metal project case history
sources_and_scope.supports: RATIO design intent, distinctive wing-like cantilever, brick/limestone facade and red ACM; no measured elevations.

sources_and_scope.title: Kawneer Neil Armstrong Hall project page

sources_and_scope.supports: Roof/eaves plan only; not structural walls/courtyard edges.

sources_and_scope.title: Neil Armstrong Hall 2016 source photographs
sources_and_scope.supports: Qualitative canopy silhouette, red ACM, glazed facade zones and brick material. Camera headings/roll are unknown.

limitations: The orthophoto trace is roof/eaves evidence and does not verify the structural wall footprint.
The geotagged facade photos have no calibrated camera heading/roll and do not support exact facade registration.
Roof peak and warp remain photo-based inference; 21.6 m is only a coarse LiDAR ceiling, not a measured roof elevation.
No public dimensioned as-built plan or elevation was found in the R12.8 source review.
